notes: The proposed 20-frame normal buffer equals two seconds at the official 10 fps extraction rate.
This buffer is a conservative, configurable starting policy and is not claimed to be scientifically optimal.
Normal frames require a separately reviewed window that ends before the temporal exclusion buffer.
Accident frames require a separately reviewed visible-collision window because the official anomaly start can precede visible impact.
Post-anomaly frames are not used as normal examples.
